entities.name: Aevar Borg
entities.description: A Northern Guide who narrates the story and accepts the job of guiding a mysterious stranger to Ronom Glacier.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: The famed Soldevi master machinist whose Phyrexian discoveries escaped his control and destroyed Soldev; he goes to Ronom Glacier on a mission of revenge and guilt.

entities.name: Heidar of Rimewind
entities.description: A madman who wants to build an army of Phyrexian constructs awakened from the Ronom Glacier ice using scrolls of Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: A king whom Dagsson warned about Heidar.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: A mechanized city of machinist-wizards destroyed by Phyrexian machines, now a rubble-choked hole.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: A vast glacier in northern Terisiare in which Phyrexian war machines were buried in ice.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where the story takes place.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A northern land the guide proposes returning to.

entities.name: Phyrexian construct
entities.description: Giant ice-entombed Phyrexian machines, most of which had already awakened and left; one remained chained in the cavern.

entities.name: Scrolls of Lim-Dûl
aliases: scrolls from the vaults of Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Scrolls whose nonsense words awaken or free Phyrexian machines.

entities.name: The Thaw
entities.description: The ending of the Ice Age that Heidar wants to stop and the guide recalls.

entities.name: Rimewind army
entities.description: Heidar's army, which still marched across Terisiare with thousands perishing.

events.summary: Aevar Borg, guiding a wizard-looking client paid in Soldevi coins, treks toward Ronom Glacier.
events.quote: One client, a wizard judging by his garb and his rune-scarred fingertips, who had paid in Soldevi coins, in advance.

events.summary: Dagsson recounts watching Phyrexian machines swallow Soldev and reveals Heidar's plan to awaken more from the glacier, and the guide realizes who he is.
events.quote: And now a madman, Heidar of Rimewind , wants to build an army of these constructs.

events.summary: The guide recognizes his client as the master machinist Arcum Dagsson, on a mission of revenge and guilt.
They find the glacier cavern with tracks leading out; most Phyrexian machines have already awakened and left.
events.quote: The pit edges were rough, broken outward from beneath — the empty wombs of Phyrexian monsters.

events.summary: Dagsson finds one remaining chained Phyrexian construct and, gazing into its core, is overcome with horror and sobbing.
Dagsson plants a mana-activated bomb inside the construct, which awakens it.
events.quote: He lowered the thing gingerly into the Phyrexian's back, and fastened the panel shut.

events.summary: The guide climbs onto the stirring construct to reach Dagsson, whose leg is pinned and broken under a chain.
events.quote: His leg was pinned under one of the chains by the strength of the beast below us

events.summary: At Dagsson's insistence the guide reads a scroll of Lim-Dûl aloud, freeing the construct from its chains.
events.quote: I had just uttered the spell to free the Phyrexian killing machine from its bonds.

events.summary: The freed construct strides out of the cave with both men aboard and the bomb ticking.
events.quote: I remembered, now, that we were riding a bomb.

events.summary: The guide lets go of Dagsson and falls off the construct near the cave mouth.
events.quote: I prayed and let go of my client.

events.summary: The bomb explodes and destroys the Phyrexian killing machine across the valley.
events.quote: the full force of the explosion that ripped apart the killing machine

relations.note: Dagsson goes to stop Heidar's plan.
relations.quote: now I must go to stop Heidar.

relations.note: The guide works for Dagsson as a paid guide.
relations.quote: who had paid in Soldevi coins, in advance
Heidar's Rimewind army still marched across Terisiare, and thousands perished

relations.note: Soldev was a city of Terisiare.
relations.quote: Soldev was once a mechanized wonder, the triumph of the famed machinist-wizards

relations.note: It is the largest single object on Terisiare.
relations.quote: the largest single object on Terisiare
